searchScoreV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump: additive-only, no existing export signature changed

inventoryScopeV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump: additive-only, no existing export's signature changed; same precedent as cc22c7e1/a756190d/2803d3d9 (P3-3/P3-4), each of which added CoreRuntime exports without bumping abiEpoch. Amendment: inventoryOpenTreeProjectionShard adds a projection query whose visibility policy is supplied by the caller (InventoryTreeProjectionRequestV1). Same rationale -- a new export with a new request record, no existing export's shape changed. It introduces no wire message kind: the policy travels in the existing resolveRequest block's file-id section, so messageKinds and the table strides above are unchanged.
inventoryScopeV1.handleInvalidation: typed CoreError (inventoryHandleInvalidated), not a panic -- contract §4 layer 3

liveTruthReads.inventoryLookupPaths: handle selects the root; facts still read against the scope's live identity maps, not the handle's frozen generation -- see InventoryScope::lookup_paths's doc comment

swiftMirrorFingerprint.mechanism: SHA-256 of a canonical ASCII descriptor string both sides independently construct (NOT std::hash::Hash/DefaultHasher, which is unstable across Rust releases)

agentClaudeV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump at P6-6 landing (additive-only, no existing export's signature changed; same precedent as cc22c7e1/a756190d/2803d3d9/inventoryScopeV1). P6-7 amendment: agentApplyModelAndEffort changed from throws-only (void) to -> AgentClaudeFlagSettingsReceiptV1 and gained AgentClaudeFlagSettingsDispositionV1, genuine existing-export signature changes, not additive -- still no bump, because Swift bindings and the Rust FFI archive are always regenerated and rebuilt together from the same commit (never independently versioned/shipped), and buildFingerprint/bindingChecksum (recomputed and validated via staleRuntimeIdentity on every raw call) already catch any binding/archive staleness at a finer grain than abiEpoch guards; abiEpoch protects the coarse envelope/wire-format layer (header layout, payload kinds), unchanged here. P6-7 D-9/R9 also adds optional model/effort observability inputs to agentStartOrResume so Rust can reproduce the legacy session.startOrResume payload; these inputs do not alter spawn or flag-setting authority and use the same atomic-binding/no-bump rationale. See rust/ffi-contract/exports.txt's matching comments.
agentClaudeV1.scope: all four Claude-compatible runtime variants: standard Claude Code, GLM, Kimi, and custom backend

eventEnvelope.mechanism: a versioned, batched JSON object per event ({"v":1,"kind":...}), crossing on the existing generic openSubscription/tryDrain surface -- no per-domain subscribe export, same precedent as inventoryScopeV1
eventEnvelope.lossClassification: contract §7.1 -- lossless/coalescible/droppable per kind, with sessionStateChanged's is_idle field (not the kind alone) selecting lossless vs coalescible

agentClaudeV1.inv_p6_1: no export accepts a single protocol line; the temporary P6-5 debug shadow export was deleted at P6-10 after Rust became the sole authority for all Claude-compatible variants
agentClaudeV1.sessionPersistence: unchanged -- AgentSession/AgentSessionIndex stay Swift-owned for the whole vertical (design §6); Rust holds live-run state in memory only

agentSessionHostV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump at ADR-0011 P2 landing: two new objects (AgentHostProtocolV1, AgentSessionLog) and their records/enums/errors, no existing export's signature changed -- same precedent as inventoryScopeV1/agentClaudeV1. buildFingerprint and bindingChecksum rotate once (exports.txt and abi-v1.json are fingerprint inputs), which is the design §11 row 3 'fingerprint 轮换一次'.

schema.frozen: end of P2; incompatible changes bump PROTOCOL_VERSION (wire) or SCHEMA_VERSION (.events/.snapshot header) and older runtimes refuse the newer value (ADR-0006)
schema.codec: prost 0.14.4 types rendered by xtask (protox 0.9.1 + prost-build 0.14.4, no system protoc) into rust/crates/proto/src/generated/agent_host_v1.rs, committed and proven byte-identical by `xtask generate --check`; Swift links no protobuf runtime (design §11 编解码归属)

eventLog.header: magic (AGSL log / AGSS snapshot) || u16 schemaVersion || u16 flags (0) || 16-byte sessionID, 24 bytes
eventLog.record: u32 length || u32 CRC-32C || encoded AgentSessionEvent; record ordinal (1-based) == deliveryCursor
eventLog.tornTail: truncate to the last CRC-valid record and report the lost range; never repair from a snapshot

agentSessionHostV1.typedMirrors: every agent_host_v1 message and enum has an AgentHost<Name>V1 uniffi Record/Enum in rust/crates/ffi/src/agent_host_types.rs; unknown enum values decode to agentHostFrameMalformed (fail closed), never to Unspecified
agentSessionHostV1.bytesParameters: only complete wire frames, snapshot bodies, and the 4-byte length prefix cross as bytes; they are the project-owned wire format (charter §14.2), never provider protocol lines (INV-P6-1 untouched)
agentSessionHostV1.runtimeIdentityDecision: the codec is a pure function of bytes and the log is a file handle; build identity for the host protocol is checked by the handshake itself (Hello/Welcome.buildFingerprint, bidirectional)
agentSessionHostV1.syncPolicy: append takes AgentSessionLogDurabilityV1 {sync, deferred}; deferred appends are synced by sync/compact/close at turn boundaries (design §7.2 write path, SLO agentSessionHostV1.eventLogFsyncTurnLatency)

agentRunLifecycleV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump at ADR-0011 P6-a landing: five new objects (AgentRunLifecycleTrackerV1, AgentRunProcessIdentityStateV1, AgentRunTerminalCommitStateV1, AgentRunTerminalSettlementCoordinatorV1, AgentRunSemanticAuthorityV1), their AgentRun*V1 records/enums, and one error variant; no existing export's signature changed -- same precedent as agentSessionHostV1. buildFingerprint and bindingChecksum rotate once.
agentRunLifecycleV1.swiftOriginals: Sources/RepoPromptDomainRuntime/DomainAgentRun*.swift (retained until the GUI cutover, ADR-0011 decision 11; the Rust module is the future single owner, proven equivalent first)
agentRunLifecycleV1.determinism: pure value-state reducers: no clock, no UUID minting, no I/O; timestamps and every identity (attempt, binding generation, commit, token, process run) are inputs. Swift's `UUID()` defaults become explicit AgentRunBeginAttemptV1 fields.
agentRunLifecycleV1.canonicalState: canonicalState() renders the Swift package-visible state as fixed-key-order JSON (agent_run_lifecycle::canonical); Swift-private fields (nextSequence, phaseOwnership, settlement collections) are proven through behavior, not rendered
agentRunLifecycleV1.differentialHarness: Tests/RepoPromptDomainRuntimeTests/DomainAgentRunRustDifferentialTests.swift drives both implementations over every Swift scenario plus a seeded random corpus and asserts identical typed outputs and canonical state
agentRunLifecycleV1.wireProjection: agent_run_lifecycle::proto maps to/from the frozen agent_host_v1 RunLifecycleEvent vocabulary (LifecycleStage, RetryIntent, EpochTransitionKind, TerminalOutcome, TerminationSignal, FailureReason) fail-closed on *_UNSPECIFIED; wire TurnEpoch is a documented lossy projection of the domain epoch (turn_id/epoch/transition only)
agentRunLifecycleV1.bytesParameters: none; every parameter and result is a typed AgentRun*V1 record/enum, a UUID string, a u64, or a bool
agentRunLifecycleV1.runtimeIdentityDecision: pure value reducers embedded by the host; there is no runtime authority to fence and no process-owned resource behind the object
agentRunLifecycleV1.fuzzDecision: no bytes are decoded across this surface (typed mirrors only); invariants are covered by property tests (rust/crates/runtime/tests/agent_run_lifecycle_property.rs) and the Swift differential corpus. Wire decoding of RunLifecycleEvent is already fuzzed by agent_host_frame_v1.

agentSessionTranscriptV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump at ADR-0011 P6-b landing: one new object (AgentSessionTranscriptReducerV1) reusing existing AgentHost*V1 records/enums; no new error variant; no existing export's signature changed -- same precedent as agentRunLifecycleV1. buildFingerprint and bindingChecksum rotate once.
agentSessionTranscriptV1.swiftOriginals: Sources/RepoPromptDomainRuntime/AgentSessionHost/AgentSessionHostSessionState.swift (retained until the host cutover, ADR-0011 decision 11; the Rust module is the future single owner, proven equivalent first)
agentSessionTranscriptV1.determinism: pure value-state reducer: no clock, no UUID minting, no I/O; recorded_at, cursor, generation, and attached-client count are inputs. The host still appends via AgentSessionLog FFI.
agentSessionTranscriptV1.canonicalState: canonicalState() renders the Swift package-visible state as fixed-key-order JSON; Swift-private assistantDraft is proven through flush/discard behavior, not rendered
agentSessionTranscriptV1.differentialHarness: Tests/RepoPromptDomainRuntimeTests/AgentSessionTranscriptRustDifferentialTests.swift drives both implementations over every Swift reducer branch plus a seeded random corpus and asserts identical snapshots and canonical state
agentSessionTranscriptV1.wireProjection: the reducer consumes the frozen agent_host_v1 AgentSessionEvent family and emits TranscriptEntry / AgentSessionSnapshot; schema is not changed. Documented gaps: StreamResult tool_*/reasoning fields are ignored (Swift never folds them); latestAssistantPreview truncates by Unicode scalar in Rust vs Character in Swift (BMP/ASCII agree); proto TurnEpoch remains the P6-a lossy projection
agentSessionTranscriptV1.bytesParameters: generation and snapshot.generation only; every other parameter and result is a typed AgentHost*V1 record/enum, a string, a u64/u32, or a bool
agentSessionTranscriptV1.runtimeIdentityDecision: pure value reducer embedded by the host; there is no runtime authority to fence and no process-owned resource behind the object
agentSessionTranscriptV1.fuzzDecision: no bytes are decoded across this surface (typed AgentHost*V1 mirrors only); invariants are covered by property tests (rust/crates/runtime/tests/agent_session_transcript_property.rs) and the Swift differential corpus. Wire decoding of AgentSessionEvent is already fuzzed by agent_host_frame_v1 / agent_session_log_frame_v1.

agentProviderSemanticsV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump at ADR-0011 P6 leftover / P7 landing: additive AgentProviderCodexLifecycleV1 (Codex bash/file-change lifecycle synthesis) plus AgentProviderCodexLifecycleEventV1 / BashItemV1 / RunningUpdateV1 / RunningApplyV1 records. agentProviderSemanticsV1.swiftOriginals: CodexNativeSessionController / ACPDefaultSessionUpdateNormalizer / MCPIntegrationHelper.repoPromptPermissionAutoApprovalMatch (retained; GUI/host rewire is a later cutover)
agentProviderSemanticsV1.determinism: pure functions and value-state reducers: no clock, no UUID minting, no I/O; fallback tool-call ids, run/turn ids, and request ids are inputs
agentProviderSemanticsV1.canonicalState: canonicalState() / evaluate().canonical render fixed-key-order JSON for the Swift differential harness
agentProviderSemanticsV1.wireProjection: outputs use the frozen agent_host_v1 RuntimeEvent / ApprovalRequest / PermissionPolicy / ToolDisposition vocabulary. agentProviderSemanticsV1.bytesParameters: none; JSON params cross as strings (already-parsed transport payloads)
agentProviderSemanticsV1.runtimeIdentityDecision: pure value reducers embedded by the host; there is no runtime authority to fence and no process-owned resource behind the object
agentProviderSemanticsV1.fuzzDecision: this surface does not decode untrusted wire bytes; JSON-RPC framing remains owned by provider_json_rpc and is already fuzzed by existing provider/host frame targets. workspaceAuthorityV1.abiEpochDecision: no bump: additive-only, new CoreRuntime exports, transaction commit_direct methods, and CorePreparedWorkspaceCommandAdmissionV1 query methods; buildFingerprint and bindingChecksum rotate once via xtask generate.
